T-061 stays blocked on the one existing ask: the GrowthClub Tantra API key (T-337). Everything that needs no key is built, live and pushed.

COMPLETION CHECK

- **Lane routing code, migration 0023, simulator route, probe:** done. `app/scripts/probe-lanes.mjs` passed 18 of 18 on an isolated local stack this run: each lane's sign-up lands only in its own campaign, with lane, cohort week and UTM, and no double push.
- **Deploy of lane routing:** done. The live Worker's `/admin/api/lanes` answers with both campaign names, and the remote D1 has no migrations left to apply. It reports `key_saved: false` and routing is off.
- **Lane Economics tab (registrations, VIP sales, seat sales, revenue, cost per weekly cohort):** done. I read it back from the [Tantra Tracker sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1clliPUw9w5kOL9CJmV2i8v62zwhJh9TLU3DyA1-M8Dc/edit?v=t061b#gid=1391694731) after a live `tracker_sync.py` run.
- **Both lanes shown for the 7 to 9 Oct cohort:** rows are there, but every count is 0. The 7 Oct cohort had dropped off the tab, so I changed `lane_economics` to list every weekly cohort with both lanes. No real sign-ups or sales exist yet, only one test registration, which sits in the 14 Oct free row.
- **Commit and push:** done, with one oddity. The `tracker_sync.py` fix was swept into another lane's commit (`fba5f14`, labelled T-334), so there is no separate T-061 commit. It is on `main` and pushed (0 commits ahead of origin).
- **Two live Tantra campaigns and one [email] test sign-up per lane:** blocked. Needs the Tantra API key pasted at https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/#settings, field Tantra API key.
- **Pass review and move to status review:** not done; it follows the live step above.
- **Ripple R-070d2970 (T-247):** nothing to change. T-061's text does not describe how the script gets its Mongo URI.
- **Board:** status is blocked with the T-337 ask kept as the only one, reviewers are Aquila and Bharath, and both notes are acknowledged.
